title: Tick frame
description: The data of the panel socket's `ticks/<instrumentId>` topic (decision 0019 d12): one instrument's last price, and its mark where the runtime has one, sent when either changes; the last one first on subscribe. It flows only while something else holds the instrument's market data (the trade screen's book, trades or price header, a bot, an armed stop): the topic opens no stream of its own. Also the data of the deprecated `ticks` topic, which carries every watched instrument (removed in the release after V1). Mirrors `formTick` in src/domain/marketdata/feed.ts.

instrumentId.description: The instrument's id, as in the topic.

last.description: The last trade's price, else the mid.

decimal.description: A plain non-negative decimal string. Never a JSON number.
